title: Measure fertility, fairness, and digit cuts
brief: Measure how many tokens a tokeniser spends per word and per character, and see how the training text decides what a script and a number cost.
hints: fertility is len(encode(text, merges)) / len(text.split()). Split on whitespace, not with _pretokenize.
tokens_per_char divides by len(text), which counts characters. With no merges a three-byte character costs 3.0.
digit_token_lengths encodes the text, looks up vocab[i] for every id with build_vocab(merges), counts the bytes in range 48 to 57, and keeps counts above 0.
